description: The state of a curation task in its lifecycle.
name: TaskState

enum.name: NOT_STARTED
enum.description: The task has been created and assigned but work has not yet started.

enum.name: IN_PROGRESS
enum.description: The assignee has actively started the task.

enum.name: EXECUTING
enum.description: An automated execution (async job) is currently running for this task.

enum.name: IN_REVIEW
enum.description: The automated execution completed successfully and the results are pending human review.

enum.name: COMPLETED
enum.description: The task has been completed and verified.

enum.name: CANCELED
enum.description: The task has been canceled and is no longer needed.
